title: Reacticx component config
description: Configuration for the reacticx CLI. Every key is optional — anything left out falls back to the default shown here.

outDir.description: Where components are written, relative to the project root.

structure.description: How component folders are laid out inside outDir. category → outDir/molecules/accordion; flat → outDir/accordion; mirror → the library's own nested layout.

typescript.description: The library ships TypeScript source. Turn this off only if your toolchain strips types itself.

aliases.description: Import prefixes written into copied files. An empty string makes that import relative instead.

paths.description: Where everything other than components lands, relative to the project root.

include.description: What gets copied alongside each component.

examples.description: The example screen that documents the component.

dependencies.description: Follow the source's own imports and copy the components and helpers they point at.

installDependencies.description: What to do about npm packages the copied source imports and the project does not have.

registry.description: The reacticx-codebase bucket the CLI reads from.

origin.description: Public origin of the bucket, no trailing slash.

index.description: Key of the object listing every file in the bucket.

registry.description: Key of the component metadata document.

cache.description: false, or how long the two listings are cached on disk, in seconds.
